fusions.name: Banked Ember
fusions.desc: Throws an ember banked under your shell that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 10 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Vent the Kiln
fusions.desc: Vents the heat stored in your shell, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocks them back 3 tiles and sets them [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hearth Within
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Blood Warmed
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, the heat warms your blood and you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
